note: Cordon's thirteen sources, all official. OSAC is excluded: its terms bar publishing or harvesting without authorization.

sources.name: US Department of State travel advisories (JSON)
sources.licence: US public domain (seals and logos restricted)

sources.name: US embassy alert RSS feeds (per post)
EASA Conflict Zone Information Bulletins (CSV export)
NGA Maritime Safety Information navigational warnings in force (daily text lists; the JSON API when it answers with current data)
FAA National Airspace System status, airport events (the JSON behind nasstatus.faa.gov)
sources.licence: US Government work, not subject to US copyright (17 U.S.C. 105); the FAA states no licence on nasstatus

sources.name: UK FCDO foreign travel advice (GOV.UK Content API: index and country pages)
FAA temporary flight restrictions (tfr.faa.gov list JSON and detail XML)
sources.licence: US Government work, not subject to US copyright (17 U.S.C. 105); the FAA states no licence on the TFR site

sources.name: Government of Canada travel advice and advisories (open.canada.ca dataset bef2ebb3-ca9a-485f-aaff-5dc36eb89426, data.international.gc.ca JSON index)
CDC Travelers' Health travel notices (RSS)
sources.licence: US public domain; CDC asks for credit (Source: CDC), a no-endorsement disclaimer and unaltered substance

sources.name: New Zealand SafeTravel travel advice (MFAT; destination list embedded in safetravel.govt.nz/destinations, and country pages)
sources.licence: Crown copyright, Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (attribute the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade; no logos; design and imagery excluded)

sources.name: Japan Ministry of Foreign Affairs overseas safety information open data (外務省 海外安全情報オープンデータ: newest notices, and one country file for danger levels 1-4)
sources.licence: Government Standard Terms 2.0 (terms page of 25 Nov 2026: free to copy, publicly transmit and adapt, commercial use allowed; state the source '出典：外務省 海外安全情報オープンデータ' with the page URL; say when the content was edited or processed and never present it as made by the State; compatible with CC BY 4.0; logos and symbol marks excluded)

sources.name: Netherlands travel advice (reisadvies) with colour codes, Nederland Wereldwijd open data API (Ministry of Foreign Affairs)
sources.licence: CC0 1.0 (data.overheid.nl dataset 'Reisadviezen op nederlandwereldwijd.nl', read 25 Nov 2026; the API states no licence line)

sources.name: FAA Prohibitions, Restrictions and Notices (faa.gov/air_traffic/publications/us_restrictions: SFARs and KICZ NOTAMs for foreign airspace)
sources.licence: US Government work, not subject to US copyright (17 U.S.C. 105); the FAA states no licence on the page

sources.name: FAA NOTAM Management Service API (NMS-API): every active NOTAM, one bulk pull a day and deltas; the suite's one NOTAM reader, published as subset files under /data/notams/; every feature of every pull kept for good as daily release assets (nms-archive-YYYY-MM)
sources.licence: FAA NMS-API terms of service (7 Oct 2026): redistribution allowed; not to be called FAA data; not authoritative for NOTAMs issued outside the United States. Access by FAA approval: production granted 18 Nov 2026 (keys moved here from Launch)

sources.name: Overseas Security Advisory Council reports
sources.licence: Terms bar publishing or harvesting without authorization

state-travel-advisories.descriptor: Official advisories, 218 entries, level 1-4 with full text

us-embassy-alerts.descriptor: Per-post WordPress RSS; the type is in the title prefix

easa-czib.descriptor: Bulletin table with number, revision, valid-until and status

faa-nas-status.descriptor: Ground stops, ground delay programs and airport closures in effect, with UTC times and airport coordinates; keyless, checked live 13 Nov 2026

uk-fcdo-travel-advice.descriptor: 226 countries with the FCDO's advise-against statements and its own note of each update; keyless, checked live 14 Nov 2026

faa-tfr.descriptor: Temporary flight restrictions with NOTAM text, UTC times and the FAA's own outline; keyless, checked live 14 Nov 2026

gac-travel-advisories.descriptor: 230 places with Canada's advisory level 0-3, regional advisories and its own note of each update, in one file; keyless, checked live 14 Nov 2026

cdc-travel-notices.descriptor: Travel health notices, level 1-4, with disease, places and publication date (22 on 14 Nov 2026); keyless, checked live 14 Nov 2026

nz-mfat-safetravel.descriptor: 222 destinations with New Zealand's advice level and update date in one page, and each country page's note of other levels in some areas; keyless, checked live 14 Nov 2026

jp-mofa-overseas-safety.descriptor: The ministry's 24 newest notices (consular mail, spot and wide-area information, danger information) and, per country, the danger levels 1-4 in force and its latest danger headline, in Japanese; keyless XML, listing refreshed every 5 minutes, checked live 25 Nov 2026

nl-minbuza-travel-advice.descriptor: 226 destinations with the Netherlands' colour code (green, yellow, orange, red; more than one where it differs by area) in the page introduction, in Dutch, and the page's last-modified time; keyless XML, 200 documents a request; checked live 25 Nov 2026

faa-prohibitions-notices.descriptor: SFARs and KICZ NOTAMs for US operators in foreign airspace, by country or region (20 sections, 8 SFARs, 22 KICZ NOTAMs on 15 Nov 2026); one page, keyless, checked live 15 Nov 2026
